steps.en: Furnished hirer becomes the offender and the notice is queued for the 1st letter
steps.id: Hirer yang di-furnish jadi offender dan NOPO masuk antrean 1st letter

steps.en: Daily job picks notices due for the 1st letter
steps.id: Job harian memilih NOPO yang sudah waktunya 1st letter
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: Letter goes to the address the owner gave for the hirer
steps.id: Surat dikirim ke alamat yang diberikan owner untuk hirer

steps.en: A print data file for the vendor is generated
steps.id: File data untuk dicetak vendor dibuat

steps.en: File is stored and encrypted for sending
steps.id: File disimpan dan dienkripsi untuk dikirim

steps.en: File is sent to the print vendor
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is switched off by configuration in all environments, so the file does not arrive.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan lewat konfigurasi di semua environment, jadi file tidak sampai.

steps.en: After sending, the notice moves on to the 2nd reminder stage
steps.id: Setelah terkirim, NOPO pindah ke stage reminder ke-2
steps.why_en: The stage advances even when the file was not delivered, so the hirer may never get the 1st letter.
steps.why_id: Stage tetap maju walau file tidak terkirim, jadi hirer bisa tidak pernah menerima 1st letter.
